subject: RETURN statement
notes:
RULE (cite.py --check 14.9.34.4 'control is transferred to imperative-statement-2, if specified; otherwise, control is transferred to the end of the RETURN statement.' -> OK, 14.9.34.4 rule 4). The rule is an ORDERING: record made available, THEN any implicit INTO move, THEN imperative-statement-2. CODE (read line by line): SortEmitter.EmitReturn:165-176 emits, inside 'if (CobolSort.Return(sd, out tmp))', exactly (1) EmitImageInto(rt.RecordArea, tmp) - the record made available; (2) the 13.18.43 GR15 DEPENDING-length store; (3) 'if (rt.Into is { } into) move.Emit(...)' - the implicit move; (4) 'if (rt.NotAtEnd is { } not) Statements.EmitStatementList(not)'. When NOT AT END is unwritten nothing is emitted and control leaves the if-block - the 'otherwise' arm, observed directly in probe p1 (a phrase-less RETURN falls straight through to the following DISPLAY). INTO=1ONE
AREA=2TWO
